paite: Huan Uzziah tapa Jotham tapa Ahaz vaihawm lai in hichi ahi a, Siria kumpipa Rezin leh Israel kumpipa Remaliah tapa Pekah Jerusalem sim ding in akuantou ua; himahleh azou kei uhi.
heading: Kumpipa Ahaz A Dia Thugen
english: It happened in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

paite: Siria leh Ephraim apangkhawmta uh chi in David inkuanpihte ahilh ua, huchi in alungtang leh akhua-le-tuite lungtang, gamnuai singte huih in amutling suausuau bang in, hihlin in ahong omta hi.
english: It was told the house of David, saying, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Isai kiang ah, "Nang leh na tapa Shear-jashub, dil saknungzaw pen tuilakna tawp ah, Puansawpmi gam lamlian ah, Ahaz dawn ding in kuankhia unla;
english: Then Yahweh said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.

paite: akiang ah, pilvang inla om kinken in; meisel sum khu lel nih, Siria toh Rezin leh Remaliah tapa hehna thupitak kihta ke'nla, na lungtang taikek kei hen.
english: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

paite: Siria in, Ephraim leh Remaliah tapa toh nangmah tung a gitlouh asawm tak ziak in, chi in achi hi.
english: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,

paite: Judah dou ding in kuantou ni in, va hihlau ni, eimah a ding ngei in i va zou dia, alaitak ah kumpipa in Tabeel tapa i tusak ding," chi in.
english: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king in its midst, even the son of Tabeel.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichibang in achi, "Athusawm uh apiching kei dia, avuaksuak ding.
english: This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”

paite: Siria lutang Damaskas ahi a, Damaskas lutang Rezin lah ahi ngal a; kum sawmguk leh kum nga man ma in Ephraim chi chihtak louh a om ding in suksiat vek in a-om ding.
english: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people;

paite: Huan Ephraim lutang Samaria ahi a, Samaria lutang Remaliah tapa lel ahih ziak in. Na up nop kei uleh hihkip in na om kei hial ding uh, chi in," achi hi.
english: and the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Ahaz ahoupih nawn a,
heading: Immanuel Chiamtehna
english: Yahweh spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

paite: "TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah chiamtehna ngen in; thukpi ah hiam, tunglam sangpi ah hiam ngen in," achi hi.
english: “Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”

paite: Ahaz in bel, "Ka ngen kei ding, TOUPA ka ze-et kei ding," achi hi.
english: But Ahaz said, “I will not ask, neither will I tempt Yahweh.”

paite: Huan ama'n, "David inkuanpihte aw, tu in ngaikhe dih ua; mihing hihgim thil neuchik ding in na sep uh maw, ka Pathian nangawn hihgim na ut zel uh?
english: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA mahmah in chiamtehna nou ahon pe ding; ngai un, nungak siangthou khat agai ding a, tapa anei ding a, amin 'Immanuel' asa ding uh.
english: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel. “Immanuel” means “God with us.”

paite: Ama'n thil hoih lou lam deihlouhna dan atheih chiang in leh thil hoih lam deihna dan atheih chiang in bawngnawi dat leh khuaizu ane ding.
english: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good.

paite: Naupang thil hoih lou lam deihlouhna dan leh thil hoih lam deihna dan atheih ma in leng na lauh kumpipa nihte gam nutsiat in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: For before the child knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.

paite: "Ephraim in Judah anutsiat ni a kipan tung ngei nai lou nite TOUPA'N na tung ah leh na khua-le-tuite tung ah leh na pa inkuanpihte tung leh Assuria kumpipa mahmah tung ah atungsak ding hi.
english: Yahweh will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N Aigupta luinak a thoute leh Assuria gam a khuai omte singsit in asam ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

paite: Huchi in ahong pai ding ua, avek un phaizang leh kense lak ah, suangpi hawm ah, loulingnei tengteng leh gantatna mun tengteng ah adim ding uhi.
english: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in Toupa'n mulmet tem kikhel in, Luipi khen gam a Assuria kumpipa omte zang in, lutang leh khemul ametsiang ding a; khamul leng ametsiang vek ding hi.
english: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.

paite: "Huchi in huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, mi khat in bawngla khat leh belam nih kia avul ding.
english: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep;

paite: Himahleh hichi ahi ding a, nawitui tampi aneih ding ziak un nawituidat anesak ding; gamsung a om lai mi'n nawituidat leh khuaizu ne chiat ding ahi ngal ua.
english: and it shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter: for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left in the midst of the land.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, mun chih, grepgui sang, dangka sang man omna peuhmahte loulingnei leh khaulingnei omna lel ahita ding.
english: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silver shekels, shall be for briers and thorns.

paite: Gam pumpi loulingnei leh khaulingnei ngen ahong hih tak ziak in huai ah thaltang leh thalpeu tawi in apai ding uhi.
english: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.

paite: Huchi in mual, tupi a tohsa teng ah, loulingnei leh khaulingnei kihtak ziak in na hong pai kei ding a, bawngtalte tatsakna leh belam gamtatna mun ding lel ahita ding hi,” achi hi.
english: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of sheep.”
